story.title: Google fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI

draft:
Google's use of AI to identify bugs has led to a significant increase in fixes. 
I've been following the updates and it's clear that AI is becoming a key tool in bug detection. 
The fact that more bugs were fixed in June than in the past two years is impressive. 
What role do you think AI will play in software development in the future?
#AIinSoftware #Chrome #BugDetection
